newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Vietnam sells 1 bln dong T-notes, rate 12.00 pct.
newsitem.headline: Vietnam sells 1 bln dong T-notes, rate 12.00 pct.

text.p: Vietnam sold 1.0 billion dong ($85,800) worth of one-year Treasury notes with an annual coupon of 12.00 percent to one domestic institution at an auction on Wednesday, an official at the State Bank of Vietnam said.
At the last auction of government paper, on March 19, the central bank sold 50 billion dong worth of one-year notes at a rate of 12.00 percent.
The issue date of the notes sold on Wednesday is April 4.

The bank said Petrolimex joint-stock insurance company was the only one of three bidders to be allocated stock. It said the rates bid, of which the highest was 12.5 percent, were higher than the Ministry of Finance was prepared to accept.
The bank had originally said 70 billion dong worth of one-year notes were on offer at the auction.
